- August 27 performance: 4-for-5, 2 HR, 4 RBI, 4 runs in Brewers 8-2 win vs. Mets
- That was his 5th career multi-HR game, 3rd of 2026 season
**MEDIUM confidence:**
- Exact total career HRs (approaching 60, confirmed "one more needed" by Yahoo Sports article)
